== Title ==
<span lang="ja">チューバッカ</span><ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The title has one printed uniqueness mark.

== Card Text ==
<blockquote lang="ja">ハンと同じ位置カードにいるなら戦闘力＋1。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。ミレニアム・ファルコンに乗っているならさらに回避値に1を加える。彼と同じ位置カード上のビークルやドロイドは、“命中” しても（ロストデッキのかわりに）ユーズドデッキに行く。</blockquote><ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Lore ==
<blockquote lang="ja">キャッシーク出身のウーキーの<u>密輸屋</u>。200歳を越えている。腕利きの整備士にしてパイロット。ジャバはこの “歩き回るカーペット” にも多額の賞金をかけている。仲間からは “チューイー” とか、“毛むくじゃら” と呼ばれている。</blockquote><ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
English reading aid translated from the Japanese face; AI translation independently checked against the Japanese face.

Title: Chewbacca

Lore:
<blockquote>A Wookiee smuggler from Kashyyyk. He is over 200 years old. A skilled mechanic and pilot. Jabba has also placed a large bounty on this “walking carpet.” His companions call him “Chewie” or “Fuzzball.”</blockquote>

Card text:
<blockquote>Power +1 if at the same location card as Han. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Millennium Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Vehicles and droids on the same location card as him go to the Used Deck (instead of the Lost Deck) even if they are “hit.”</blockquote>

=== Comparison with the English printing ===
The Japanese last sentence names vehicles and droids; the English printed face names “your vehicles, starships and droids.” The Japanese sentence has no word corresponding to “your” and uses 位置カード (location card), whereas the English face says “same site.” For Millennium Falcon, the Japanese text says “aboard”; the English face says “On Millennium Falcon.” The Japanese printing also uses deck terminology where the English printing says Used Pile and Lost Pile. The printed numerical statistics, Alien/Rebel symbols, Pilot symbol and Warrior symbol match the inspected English face.<ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The comparison uses the [[:File:ANH-L-chewbacca-decipher-archive.gif|original English card face]].

== Statistics ==
The printed values and symbols are shown above. The face prints an Alien symbol, a Rebel symbol, one Pilot symbol and one Warrior symbol. Its lore identifies a Wookiee smuggler.<ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Base landspeed is 1 under the character movement rule; this is a rule-derived value, not a printed statistic.<ref name="character-landspeed">[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]]: “Characters have landspeed of 1.”</ref>

Base defense value is 2, derived from the printed ability of 2 and the absence of armor, under the Glossary defense-value rule.<ref name="defense-rule">[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], p. 47, “defense value”.</ref>
